note: Grade equivalences, shared by the collector and the site so a bar read off a page and a grade typed by a visitor end up on the same scale. Everything is normalised to the UK percentage, because that is the scale the classifications are actually defined against. A linear (gpa / 4) x 100 was the obvious conversion and is wrong: it makes GPA 3.0 into 75%, when the published equivalence puts it level with a 2:1 at 60% — which would have made every American award look stricter than an identical British one and hidden it from people who qualify.
caveat: These are approximate. No official universal conversion exists, universities publish their own tables, and a borderline case is decided by an admissions office rather than by arithmetic. Used only to hide awards clearly out of reach, never to rank anybody.
